name: print-social-novavista-discover-your-potential-post-with-violet-tinted-office
title: Novavista 'Discover Your Potential With Us.' post with a violet-tinted office photo
whatItIs: A square post with a navy top section holding the green logo, a white headline, body copy and a green 'Get in touch now!' button, an indigo side block with a ghost 'N', and a bottom photo of people working at monitors tinted violet.
whatItMeans: Inviting and on-brand; tinting the office photo keeps the palette unified.
techniques: Tint the photo in the brand's secondary colour.
Stack text block over a photo strip.
Repeat the ghost N for recognition.

vocabulary.definition: A single-hue overlay on a photo.
Marketing a company as a place to work.
